title: Whales went through a manatee phase #shorts

title: Only one human has been excavated from the La Brea Tar Pits #shorts

psychology_hypothesis: Numerical imbalance opens a specific mystery; correction establishes uncertainty.
transfer_to_our_short: Evidence puzzle is useful; avoid withholding our entire answer for a promo.

creator: PBS Eons
title: Were Neandertals morning people?
observed_structure: Your morning habits → ancient ancestry → genes → adaptation.
psychology_hypothesis: Personal relevance is plausible; technical explanation adds processing load.
transfer_to_our_short: Do not start our Short with study terminology or a taxonomy lecture.

title: Adult Cats Only Meow At Humans #shorts

psychology_hypothesis: Familiar personal experience makes the answer easy to use and share.
transfer_to_our_short: Make the mystery understandable before introducing environmental DNA; do not import its absolute biological claim.

creator: MinuteEarth
title: Opossum vs Possum #shorts

psychology_hypothesis: Two-item structure limits memory load; parallel ending supplies closure.
transfer_to_our_short: Contrast body evidence with molecular evidence, not five unrelated facts.

creator: MinuteEarth
title: Hyena Families #Shorts

psychology_hypothesis: Initial contradiction is clear; enumerated taxonomy may dilute the original question.
transfer_to_our_short: Keep only facts needed to solve one clue. Lower public count does not establish retention failure.

creator: Zack D. Films
title: How Stitches Work 😯

psychology_hypothesis: Each causal step answers what happens next; explicit final state closes the process.
transfer_to_our_short: Show DNA fragment → mineral attachment → extraction/matching as meaningful actions, not decorative orbiting.

creator: Cleo Abram
title: Your Map Shows Antarctica Wrong

psychology_hypothesis: Mental-model correction is specific; a resolved mechanism supports a second curiosity.
transfer_to_our_short: Present-day Greenland vs ancient ecosystem; preserve the local North Greenland scope.

creator: Cleo Abram
title: Why Is the Sun Jiggling?

psychology_hypothesis: Obstacle/solution produces progression; multiple concepts cost time.
transfer_to_our_short: One scientific obstacle only. Discovery listing had a different title: use fetched current title.

creator: Cleo Abram
title: You’re Dead. What Next?

psychology_hypothesis: Numbered progress gives a reason to continue; taboo topic may add salience.
transfer_to_our_short: Borrow progress and payoff, not morbidity; length alone is not a universal rule.

creator: Cleo Abram
title: Why Are Zombies Green?

psychology_hypothesis: Answer revision keeps an explicit question active; seasonal relevance is a confound.
transfer_to_our_short: Mastodon is evidence, not resurrection. No fake zombies or dinosaur DNA.

creator: Cleo Abram
title: They Spent 378 Days Locked Inside
observed_structure: Isolation on Mars → immediate simulation qualification → constraints → preparation → next topic.
psychology_hypothesis: Concrete constraints make an abstract challenge tangible.
transfer_to_our_short: Scientific qualifier must arrive with the claim, not hidden at the end.

creator: MrBeast
title: Would You Fly To Paris For A Baguette?

psychology_hypothesis: Clear objective gives an easy mental progress bar; creator reach and budget strongly confound transfer.
transfer_to_our_short: Borrow mission clarity: identify an animal without a body. Do not copy money/giveaways.

title: If Cleaning Was a Timed Sport. Part 2
